## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Saarland lights up on the map of Germany.
> Saarland | Landeshauptstadt Saarbrücken

[dramatic] [[Saarland]], in the south-west, on the French border, is the smallest state apart from the three city-states. After the war it was run separately, under French influence, and it only joined West Germany in 1957.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Saarland, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> SAARLAND

## On the map

{Q418}

> SCENE (question): Question card #418. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist das Saarland?]] Which federal state is Saarland?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[2]]. Number two: the small state in the far south-west, on the French border.


{Q417}

> SCENE (question): Question card #417. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt des Saarlandes heißt …]] The state capital of Saarland is...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Saarbrücken.]] The other three are real cities in Saarland, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q415}

> SCENE (question): Question card #415. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge des Saarlandes?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Saarland?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[schwarz-rot-gold]]. Black, red and gold, like the German flag, with the coat of arms on it.


{Q411}

> SCENE (question): Question card #411. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Saarland?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the state of Saarland?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 4]], picture four: four parts, with lions, a cross and small eagles.


## How it's run

{Q412}

> SCENE (question): Question card #412. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis im Saarland?]] Which of these is a district in Saarland?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Neunkirchen]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Mecklenburgische Seenplatte]] is in [[Mecklenburg-Vorpommern]], [[Altötting]] is in [[Bayern]], and [[Rhein-Sieg-Kreis]] is in [[Nordrhein-Westfalen]].


{Q413}

> SCENE (question): Question card #413. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag des Saarlandes gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament of Saarland elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q414}

> SCENE (question): Question card #414. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man im Saarland bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] At what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in Saarland?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[18]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from eighteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q419}

> SCENE (question): Question card #419. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef des Saarlandes?]] What is the title of the head of government of Saarland?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q420}

> SCENE (question): Question card #420. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat das Saarland nicht?]] Which of the following ministers does Saarland not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q416}

> SCENE (question): Question card #416. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich im Saarland über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information on political topics in Saarland?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Saarbrücken, schwarz-rot-gold, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Saarbrücken]]. [[schwarz-rot-gold]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
